gitCommit.subject: feat(portal, console): one payment flow, receivers, app handoff by request id, two-person review
gitCommit.body:
feat(portal, console): one payment flow, receivers, app handoff by request id, two-person review

Owner, 2026-11-12 (not yet published):
- "Pay or renew" is one compact card: the store(s) (one preselected; several for
  a renewal), one action (renew, activate a waiting store, an employee seat at
  one store), 1/3/12 months, the server's line items and total, then the manual
  payment window. "Add a store" sits beside the stores (names checked as before,
  each activity's price and the D158 replacement note kept). The page prices
  nothing and never sends an amount.
- The window offers only the service/number pairs the server lists (Bankily and
  Sedad on 36 96 38 39 and 37 67 68 27), and sends the one chosen with the
  payer's number and the screenshot; a proof still waiting is corrected there,
  naming its revision. Nothing offered: said honestly, nothing can be sent.
- "My stores": stores, status and requests, with a clear "Pay or renew"; the
  request forms moved into the flow. The duplicate Help card is gone (the footer
  has the links, with its own spacing again).
- The activation link's request is read from the server by its id
  (GET my-subscription/pending/:rid) and fills the flow; nothing about it
  travels in the address. An employee seat requested in the app shows the
  person's name; employees are still added and verified in the app.
- Console review: where the customer says the money went; the first step opens
  the access ("verification pending"); an opened proof offers only "Deposit
  found - confirm" or Refuse, for a different administrator, with who opened it,
  when, on which version, and the 24-hour target.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
